title: ATS Base Metadata
description: Extensible base metadata schema inherited by all Claude Code tool schemas. Every tool carries at minimum 'source' and 'provenance'; Tier 1 tools carry all 5 goal fragments.

source.description: Parseable caller identifier: {caller_type}:{caller_name}. caller_type enum: skill | agent | hook | main. Examples: 'skill:feature-dev:feature-dev', 'agent:code-architect', 'hook:UserPromptSubmit', 'main:orchestrator'. Backward-compatible with existing AskUserQuestion source string.

provenance.description: Caller identity chain: session → agent → skill/hook. Present on all tiers.

experiment.description: A/B test context: template variant and experiment assignment. Present on Tier 1 only.

koth.description: KOTH/Oracle integration: ELO signals and Oracle recommendation context. Present on Tier 1 and Tier 2.

decision.description: Decision Logger join key and intent classification. Present on Tier 1 and Tier 2.

_compat.description: Backward compatibility markers. Present when migrating from legacy metadata shapes.
